name: Edge Contouring for Dual Contouring
definition: A recursive procedure that processes edges of the octree to generate triangle indices for the dual contouring mesh, handling both leaf/pseudo-leaf nodes and internal nodes by recursing into children.
summary: Edge Contouring is a recursive octree traversal that generates dual contouring mesh indices, ensuring manifold connectivity by processing edges in a specific order and resolving internal node intersections via child recursion.
